description: Internal enterprise scheduling & lifecycle management platform

architecture.pattern: Modular Frontend Monolith + Service Layer + Thin Cloud Functions
architecture.eventBus: Centralized EventBus in messages/ — named channels, logged dispatch, validated cleanup
architecture.childRule: Parent controllers MUST NOT own child DOM. Children self-mount into data-cid placeholders. Parents render only their own DOM.

phases.name: Foundation Shell
phases.description: App loads in browser, Firebase connects, auth works, router navigates. All subsequent phases depend on this.

tasks.title: index.html — Shell Document
tasks.description: Shell: CSP meta, Tailwind CDN, Firebase SDKs v10, morphdom CDN, font loading (Geist + gilroy), import map, root <div id='app'>, dark theme CSS, sidebar + topbar + mobile nav + content area + toast container + hidden page templates + navigation scripts
acceptanceCriteria: Dark palette applied: bg #080710, surface #12111A, accent #7047EB, text #F4F3F6
Sidebar visible on desktop (≥1024px), hamburger drawer on tablet, overlay on mobile
All 16 routes navigate and swap page content
Public booking route renders full-screen (no sidebar/topbar)

tasks.title: firebase.js — Firebase Init & Wrappers
tasks.description: Initialize Firebase app + auth + RTDB. Export wrapped helpers with timeout (no app-level retry — Firebase SDK handles it). Use AbortController for cancellation.
acceptanceCriteria: auth and rtdb exports are non-null
dbRead returns AsyncResult with 10s AbortController timeout
dbWrite sets data and returns AsyncResult
dbTransaction wraps runTransaction with max-wait guard
NO application-level retry for Firebase ops

tasks.title: messages/catalog.js — EventBus & Message Constants
tasks.description: Message constants: MSG.AUTH_CHANGED, MSG.BOOKING_CREATED, MSG.SLOT_SELECTED, MSG.DATE_SELECTED, MSG.SHOW_TOAST, MSG.SEARCH_CHANGED, MSG.ROW_CLICKED, MSG.ROUTE_CHANGING, MSG.TIMER_TICK, etc. Centralized EventBus with named channels, logged dispatch, validated subscriber cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: All message constants defined as frozen object
EventBus.emit(channel, data) dispatches to all subscribers
EventBus logs all messages to console.debug in dev mode
Route-generation counter for stale callback rejection

tasks.title: app.js — Bootstrap Controller + Router + Wireup
tasks.description: Create main app controller. Wire createRouter with all routes. router.onChange calls route loaders before render. Auth state listener. Subscription cleanup on route change. Mount to DOM. All components created and wired via EventBus.
acceptanceCriteria: Route loaders fetch data before render
activeSubscriptions array cleaned on route change
EventBus wiring: all components register on init

tasks.title: utils/Result.js — Fluent Error Handling
tasks.description: Implement Result (sync) + AsyncResult (async) fluent classes: .from(), .ok(), .err(), .map(), .flatMap(), .mapErr(), .tap(), .tapErr(), .recover(), .unwrap(), .unwrapOr(), .unwrapOrThrow(). Catches sync throws + async rejections.
acceptanceCriteria: AsyncResult supports .map() chaining with async mappers

tasks.title: utils/icons.js — SVG Icon Templates
tasks.description: SVG icon templates as html literals: icon.search, icon.check, icon.x, icon.chevron, icon.edit, icon.trash, icon.calendar, icon.clock, icon.users, icon.link, icon.download, icon.settings, icon.shield, icon.webhook, icon.key, icon.google, icon.microsoft, icon.spinner, icon.alert, icon.eye, icon.eyeOff, icon.copy, icon.plus, icon.dashboard, icon.chart, icon.mail, icon.bell, icon.lock, icon.globe
acceptanceCriteria: All icons render as inline SVG with currentColor stroke

phases.name: Utilities
phases.description: Datetime math, crypto, input validation. Used by all services and views. Zero Firebase dependencies.

tasks.title: utils/datetime.js — Date/Time Utilities
tasks.description: Slot generation from working hours + duration + buffer (all internal math in UTC for DST safety). Date formatting. Timezone helpers. Slot math: addMinutes, overlap detection, date range iteration, month grid.
acceptanceCriteria: generateSlots(9-5, 30min, 15min buffer) produces correct non-overlapping slots

tasks.title: utils/crypto.js — Web Crypto Wrappers
tasks.description: encryptAES256GCM, decryptAES256GCM, hashSHA256, generateRandomBytes, generateApiKey, hashApiKey (PBKDF2, 100K iterations via crypto.subtle). API key prefix: cal_live_/cal_dev_.
acceptanceCriteria: generateApiKey produces cal_live_ prefix + 32 random chars
All operations use crypto.subtle (Web Crypto API)

tasks.title: utils/validators.js — Input Validation
tasks.description: Pure validation functions returning {valid, errors: [{field, message}]}. validateEmail, validateUrl, validateRequired, validateMinLength, validateMaxLength, validateEventType, validateBookingForm, validateTimeFormat, validateWebhookUrl. Max lengths: name=200, email=254, custom=500.
acceptanceCriteria: validateEventType catches missing title, invalid duration, invalid URL
validateBookingForm handles dynamic required fields from event type config
All validators are pure functions (no side effects, no DOM access)
Unicode normalized to NFC in validate functions that accept text

phases.name: Shared Components
phases.description: Reusable UI components. Stateful components return a ctrl (controller instance). Pure presentational functions return html directly. All follow export function ComponentName() { ... return ctrl } pattern.

tasks.title: components/badge.js — Status Badge
tasks.description: badge(status, label) → colored status badge. Statuses: success (#00C48C), warning (#F5A623), danger (#FF4A5A), info (#7047EB), neutral (#8A8993).

tasks.title: components/status-dot.js — Status Indicator
tasks.description: statusDot(color) → 8px circle. Colors: green (#00C48C), yellow (#F5A623), red (#FF4A5A), gray (#8A8993).

tasks.title: components/spinner.js — Loading Spinner
tasks.description: Spinner() → loading spinner. Uses stringComponent. ctrl.show() / ctrl.hide(). Onboarded with id='spinner'.

tasks.title: components/skeleton-card.js — Card Skeleton
tasks.description: skeletonCards(count) → N card skeletons with pulse animation. Used by dashboard, event types, calendar connections views.

tasks.title: components/skeleton-table.js — Table Skeleton
tasks.description: skeletonTable(rows) → table row skeletons with pulse animation. Used by billing, contacts views.
acceptanceCriteria: skeletonTable(5) renders 5 pulse rows with column structure

tasks.title: components/empty-state.js — Empty State
tasks.description: EmptyState() → icon + title + description + optional action button. ctrl.configure({ icon, title, desc, actionLabel, onAction }). ctrl.show() / ctrl.hide().

tasks.title: components/toast.js — Toast Notifications
tasks.description: Toast() → floating notifications. ctrl.success(msg), ctrl.error(msg), ctrl.warning(msg). Auto-dismiss 4s. Listens to EventBus MSG.SHOW_TOAST.

tasks.title: components/modal.js — Modal Dialog
tasks.description: Modal() → centered dialog. ctrl.configure({ title, bodyHtml, footerHtml, onClose }). ctrl.open() / ctrl.close(). Closes on backdrop click + Escape. Traps focus. Uses closure variable _onClose, not state.
acceptanceCriteria: Focus trapped inside modal while open

tasks.title: components/confirm-dialog.js — Confirmation Dialog
tasks.description: ConfirmDialog() → 'Are you sure?' modal. ctrl.confirm({ title, message, confirmLabel, confirmStyle:'danger'|'primary', onConfirm, onCancel }). Returns promise resolved with true/false.
acceptanceCriteria: Confirm resolves true, Cancel resolves false

tasks.title: components/tab-bar.js — Tab Navigation
tasks.description: TabBar({ tabs }) → horizontal tab navigation. tabs: [{id, label}]. ctrl.getActiveTab() returns current tab id. Active tab underlined with accent color.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking tab sets active and returns id

tasks.title: components/search-input.js — Debounced Search
tasks.description: SearchInput({ placeholder, debounceMs: 300 }) → search field. Emits MSG.SEARCH_CHANGED via EventBus with query string. ctrl.clear() / ctrl.getValue().
acceptanceCriteria: ctrl.clear() resets input and emits empty query

tasks.title: components/pagination.js — Page Navigation
tasks.description: Pagination() → page buttons. ctrl.setTotalPages(n). Exposes ctrl.goPage(p), ctrl.nextPage(), ctrl.prevPage(). Shows prev/next + page numbers with ellipsis for large ranges.
acceptanceCriteria: Active page highlighted with accent bg

tasks.title: components/data-table.js — Sortable Table
tasks.description: DataTable() → sortable data table. ctrl.setColumns(cols), ctrl.setData(rows). Handles sort on column header click. Emits MSG.ROW_CLICKED via EventBus. Data in closure variables, not state.
acceptanceCriteria: Sort indicator arrow shown on active column
Row click emits MSG.ROW_CLICKED with row data

tasks.title: components/date-picker.js — Date Selector
tasks.description: DatePicker() → date carousel/calendar. ctrl.getSelectedDate(). Shows next 14 days (configurable). Disabled dates grayed out. Emits MSG.DATE_SELECTED via EventBus.
acceptanceCriteria: Dates with no availability are grayed and disabled

tasks.title: components/time-slot-grid.js — Time Slot Grid
tasks.description: TimeSlotGrid() → grid of clickable time buttons. ctrl.setSlots(slots), ctrl.getSelectedSlot(). Emits MSG.SLOT_SELECTED via EventBus. Shows timezone label. Taken slots disabled.
acceptanceCriteria: TimeSlotGrid() renders slot buttons in grid
Clicking slot highlights with accent bg and emits MSG.SLOT_SELECTED

tasks.title: components/form-field.js — Dynamic Form Field
tasks.description: formField(field, value) → renders any field type (text, textarea, select, checkbox, radio) with label + error message. Delegates to html template. Supports required indicator.
acceptanceCriteria: Error state shows red error message below field

tasks.title: components/copy-button.js — Copy to Clipboard
tasks.description: CopyButton({ text }) → button that copies text to clipboard, shows 'Copied!' feedback for 2s with success color. Uses navigator.clipboard API.

tasks.title: components/user-avatar.js — User Avatar
tasks.description: userAvatar(user, size) → circle with initials (or photo if available). Sizes: sm=32px, md=40px, lg=64px. Initials extracted from user.name, fallback to '?'.
acceptanceCriteria: Photo URL renders background-image if provided

phases.name: Services Layer
phases.description: All Firebase I/O. Every function returns AsyncResult. No view code. No app-level retry for Firebase ops (SDK handles it). Timeout with AbortController. Retry only for non-Firebase external calls.

tasks.title: services/auth.service.js — Authentication
tasks.description: Google OAuth via Firebase popup with redirect fallback. signOut. getCurrentUser. createUserProfile on first login. getUserProfile. onAuthChange → returns unsub. Emits MSG.AUTH_CHANGED via EventBus.
acceptanceCriteria: signInWithGoogle() opens popup, returns AsyncResult with user
Popup blocked → falls back to signInWithRedirect
First sign-in creates user profile in /users/{uid}
onAuthChange fires on login/logout and emits MSG.AUTH_CHANGED
Free tier defaults for new users

tasks.title: services/calendar.service.js — Calendar Connections
tasks.description: OAuth flow for Google + Microsoft with CSRF state param. Token exchange via Cloud Function. List/disconnect calendars. Sync external busy intervals → /availability. Push confirmed bookings back to external calendars. MAX_CONNECTIONS=10 enforced.
acceptanceCriteria: connectCalendar initiates OAuth with state param
OAuth callback handled via Cloud Function (tokens never in client code)
listConnections returns array with provider, email, lastSync, status
syncAvailability merges external busy intervals, marks overlapping slots
refreshTokens called 5min before expiry, retries once (non-Firebase retry OK)

tasks.title: services/event-type.service.js — Event Type CRUD
tasks.description: CRUD event types. Soft delete (active=false). Free tier max 1. Fields: title, duration, location (zoom/meet/teams/none), requiresPhi, color, active, visibility (public/hidden), bookingRules, formFields. NO price/currency fields.
acceptanceCriteria: listEventTypes filters by uid, excludes hidden from public queries
Free tier: second create returns error

tasks.title: services/booking.service.js — Atomic Slot Booking
tasks.description: Atomic slot booking via runTransaction (compare-and-swap). Creates booking + workspace atomically. Cancel/reschedule. Split PHI from non-PHI data when requiresPhi. Pre-submit check: verify event type still active. Single-use link support.
acceptanceCriteria: bookSlot uses runTransaction — concurrent bookings: one succeeds, others get 'slot taken'
cancelBooking sets slot back to 'free', booking status to 'cancelled'
Pre-submit check verifies event type exists + active
requiresPhi event types split form data: non-PHI → /bookings, PHI → /secure_phi

tasks.title: services/availability.service.js — Availability
tasks.description: Set working hours per day. Generate slots from working hours + duration + buffer. Store to /availability. Query available slots. Set booking rules (max/day, min notice, max advance, buffer). Mark slots as external_busy for calendar sync.
acceptanceCriteria: generateAndStoreSlots creates slot nodes for date with status:'free'
getAvailableSlots returns only free slots in date range
setBookingRules updates maxPerDay, minNoticeHours, maxAdvanceDays, bufferMinutes
Slot generation respects buffer minutes between slots
markSlotBusy sets status:'external_busy' for calendar sync conflicts

tasks.title: services/routing.service.js — Routing & Round-Robin
tasks.description: CRUD routing forms. Evaluate answers against rules → target pool. Round-robin: atomic counter increment + availability check + fallback chain by priority. Collective: all members free check. Pool member management with priority weights. Weighted round-robin (higher priority = more assignments).
acceptanceCriteria: evaluateRouting maps form answers to target pool based on rules
roundRobinAssign: atomic counter, returns host with lowest count, weighted by priority
roundRobinAssign fallback: if assignee busy, tries next member by priority order
collectiveCheck: finds slots where ALL pool members are simultaneously free
Pool member add/remove updates pool immediately
Empty pool returns error with fallback to pool owner
Collective pre-aggregation via Cloud Function for pools >10 members

tasks.title: services/workspace.service.js — Client Portal
tasks.description: Create workspace on booking. CRUD tasks with completion toggle. Timer: start/stop with mode (prep/session/follow-up). Elapsed via Date.now() delta. Messages. File metadata. Time tracking aggregation (no invoicing — internal tool). Timer auto-stop enforcement via Cloud Function.
acceptanceCriteria: createWorkspace initializes with empty tasks, messages, timers
addTask creates task with completed:false; toggleTask flips atomically
startTimer(mode) records start timestamp; stopTimer calculates elapsed, logs to timers/log
Timer uses Date.now() delta, not interval counting
Client warning at 8h; Cloud Function auto-stops at 8h server-side
getElapsed shows all three modes separately
No invoice generation — time tracking only

tasks.title: services/notification.service.js — Notifications
tasks.description: sendBookingConfirmation, sendCancellationNotice, sendReminder. maskPHIForNotification replaces patient name with 'Client ID #xxx'. All calls go to Cloud Function HTTP endpoint /api/notifications/send. SMS reminders via Twilio (Phase 7+).
acceptanceCriteria: sendBookingConfirmation sends POST to Cloud Function with booking data
sendReminder includes meeting date/time + join link
maskPHIForNotification replaces patient name with 'Client ID #xxx'

tasks.title: services/webhook.service.js — Webhook Subscriptions
tasks.description: Subscribe/unsubscribe webhooks. List subscriptions. Test webhook (POST test payload). Generate HMAC signing secret. Validate URL before save.
acceptanceCriteria: subscribeWebhook stores URL + events + secret to /webhook_subscriptions/{uid}/{sid}
testWebhook POSTs test payload with HMAC signature header
Invalid URL rejected by validator before save

phases.name: Views
phases.description: Page-level views composing shared components + services. Each is a factory function: export function ViewName() { ... return ctrl }. Views use EventBus for cross-component messages. Children self-mount into data-cid placeholders — parents never own child DOM.

tasks.title: Login View
tasks.description: Centered card with branding + Google sign-in button. Popup-blocker fallback. Redirect on auth. Error state for failed login.

tasks.title: Dashboard View
tasks.description: KPI cards (bookings today, pending, active workspaces). No-show rate card. Recent bookings table. Quick action buttons. Listens to MSG.BOOKING_CREATED for live updates.

tasks.title: Calendar Connections View
tasks.description: List connected calendars with provider icon, email, sync time, status dot. Connect/disconnect buttons. OAuth flow with state param. MAX_CONNECTIONS=10 indicator.

tasks.title: Event Types View
tasks.description: Event type card grid. Inline create/edit form. Delete with confirmation. Search filter. Free tier: create disabled with upgrade prompt. Link to booking page editor for each event type.

tasks.title: Availability View
tasks.description: Month calendar grid with day status dots. Slot list on day click. Working hours editor per day. Booking rules panel. Copy booking link button.

tasks.title: Public Booking Page
tasks.description: Multi-step wizard: date → slot → form → confirm → success. sessionStorage persistence. history.replaceState for steps. Real-time slot updates via onValue. Password gate if configured. Full-screen public view (no sidebar).

tasks.title: Booking Page Editor
tasks.description: 3-panel layout: block palette (Header, Description, Calendar, Form, Testimonials, FAQ, Image, Spacer, Footer) + live preview at 375px + properties panel. Layout switcher: Classic/Modern/Compact. Color picker. Button text editor. Save + preview actions.

tasks.title: Routing Forms View
tasks.description: Form list + create. Form builder: add/reorder questions with drag handles. Routing rules: if question X = answer Y → pool Z. Preview mode with sample answers.

tasks.title: Pools View
tasks.description: Pool list + detail. Member list with priority badges. Add/remove members. Strategy toggle (round-robin/collective). Assignment counts per member.

tasks.title: Workspaces List View
tasks.description: Workspace cards with client name, event type, date, task count, last message time. Click navigates to detail. Status badges (Active/Upcoming/Completed).

tasks.title: Workspace Detail View
tasks.description: 3-column: tasks checklist (add/toggle/delete) + timer (3-mode: prep/session/follow-up, large elapsed, start/pause/stop) + messages thread (send/list). Timer uses Date.now() delta. 8h warning. Access denied for non-participants.

tasks.title: Time Tracking View
tasks.description: Time entries per workspace/team member. Filter by date range. Duration totals per mode (prep/session/follow-up). No invoicing — tracking only.

tasks.title: Compliance View
tasks.description: BAA section: status, sign, download, revoke. PHI masking toggle. Notification masking settings. Data retention policy display. GDPR data residency selector.

tasks.title: Webhooks View
tasks.description: Subscription list: URL, events (badges), status dot. Add form: URL input, event checkboxes (invitee.created, invitee.canceled, routing.submitted). Test button shows response. Delete with confirmation.

tasks.title: API Keys View
tasks.description: Key list: name, prefix, scopes, created, last used. Generate: name + scope checkboxes → one-time reveal modal with copy button + red warning. Revoke with confirmation. Keys hashed with PBKDF2 before storage.

tasks.title: Settings View
tasks.description: Profile (name, email, timezone). Notification prefs (email for bookings, email for cancellations). Theme. Account deletion.

phases.name: Cloud Functions
phases.description: Server-side Firebase Functions for webhook dispatch, timer enforcement, email dispatch, OAuth token exchange. Deployed separately from frontend. Note: functions/package.json and functions/.eslintrc.js are created by `firebase init functions` (not a tracked task) — they need dependencies: firebase-functions, firebase-admin, @sendgrid/mail, crypto.

tasks.title: functions/src/dispatch-webhook.js
tasks.description: Detects booking create/update/delete. Reads webhook subscriptions for host. Dispatches POST to each subscriber URL with HMAC-SHA256 signature. 3 retries with backoff (5s/30s/300s) — non-Firebase retry OK. Dead letter queue to /webhook_failures/{sid}. Tracks delivery status.
acceptanceCriteria: Dispatches POST with HMAC signature to each subscriber
3 retries on failure with exponential backoff
Does NOT dispatch for deleted bookings

tasks.title: functions/src/enforce-timer-limit.js
tasks.description: Monitors running timers. If elapsed >8h, auto-stops server-side. Logs billing entry. Sends warning notification at 7h. Enforces max 12h cap.
acceptanceCriteria: Warning notification sent to host at 7h
Idempotent: won't double-stop already stopped timer

tasks.title: functions/src/send-notification.js
tasks.description: Receives notification request from client. Constructs email via SendGrid/Mailgun template. Masks PHI (replaces patient name with 'Client ID #xxx'). Logs delivery to /notifications/{nid}. Rate limited: max 30/min per host.
acceptanceCriteria: Accepts POST with {type, bookingId, hostId, recipient}
Constructs and sends email via SendGrid/Mailgun
PHI masked in notification body when applicable

tasks.title: functions/src/oauth-token-exchange.js
tasks.description: Handles OAuth token exchange for Google/Microsoft calendar connections. Receives auth code from client, exchanges for tokens server-side, encrypts with server-side key (AES-256-GCM), stores encrypted blob in RTDB. Client never sees raw tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Exchanges auth code for access+refresh tokens server-side
Encrypts tokens with AES-256-GCM before storage
Client never receives raw access/refresh tokens
CSRF state parameter validated on callback

phases.name: Firebase Config & Build
phases.description: RTDB security rules, Firebase project config, Vite build config, env example. Deployed last to enforce rules on completed data model.

tasks.title: database.rules.json — RTDB Security Rules
tasks.description: Complete security rules for all 12+ RTDB nodes: users (self-write), event_types, availability (slot booking guard: only free slots writable by non-host), calendar_connections (host-only), booking_rules, bookings (host+invitee read), routing_forms, routing_pools, routing_counters, workspaces (host+client read/write), secure_phi (host+invitee read, invitee write), webhook_subscriptions (host-only), api_keys (host-only), notification_prefs.
acceptanceCriteria: User can only write to own /users/{uid}
Slot booking: only free slots writable by non-host
PHI data: only host or invitee can read
API keys: only host can read/write
Calendar tokens: only host + Cloud Function can read

tasks.title: firebase.json — Project Config
tasks.description: Firebase project config: RTDB instance, emulator ports (database:9000, auth:9099, hosting:5000, functions:5001), hosting (public:'.', rewrites to index.html for SPA, /api/* → Cloud Functions), ignore patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Hosting rewrites all paths to index.html
Emulator ports specified for all services

tasks.title: vite.config.js — Vite Build Config
tasks.description: Vite zero-config build. Entry: assets/src/app.js. Output: assets/dist/bundle.js. Dev server with HMR. Firebase SDK externalized (loaded via CDN). morphdom externalized. Tailwind JIT compilation.
acceptanceCriteria: Dev server starts and HMR works
Source maps in dev, stripped in production

tasks.title: .env.example — Environment Variables
tasks.description: Documents required env vars: VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY, VITE_FIREBASE_DATABASE_URL, VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN, OAUTH_ENCRYPTION_KEY (Cloud Function only), SENDGRID_API_KEY (Cloud Function only), WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET (Cloud Function only).
acceptanceCriteria: All env vars documented with example values
Cloud Function vars clearly marked as server-only
No real secrets in example file

phases.name: Post-MVP Features (Priority 1 — Enterprise Internal)
phases.description: Features Gemini identified as critical for internal enterprise launch. Implement after core platform is stable.

tasks.title: SSO/SAML Integration
tasks.description: SAML/OIDC SSO via Firebase Auth (Google Cloud Identity Platform). Configure SAML provider in Firebase Console. Route: /login/sso. Provider discovery by email domain.

tasks.title: Audit Logging
tasks.description: Immutable append-only audit log. RTDB: /audit_logs/{timestamp}. Fields: userId, action, target, oldValue, newValue, ip. Cloud Function writes audit entries on sensitive actions. Retention: 1 year.

tasks.title: Resource Booking
tasks.description: Meeting rooms, equipment, shared spaces. RTDB: /resources/{rid}. Fields: name, type (room/equipment/space), capacity, location. Booking conflict check: resource can't be double-booked. View: /resources.

tasks.title: Video Conferencing Auto-Generate
tasks.description: Auto-generate Zoom/Meet/Teams links on booking. Event type location field: zoom/meet/teams. OAuth for Zoom + Teams. Meet links auto-generated without OAuth (use Google Calendar API). Store join link in /bookings/{bid}/location.

tasks.title: Contacts/CRM
tasks.description: Contact profiles with notes, custom fields, lists. RTDB: /contacts/{uid}/{cid}. Views: /contacts, /contacts/:id. Track lastBooking, totalBookings, noShowCount. Filter/sort by custom fields.

tasks.title: Single-Use Links
tasks.description: Time-limited, expire-after-use booking tokens. RTDB: /one_time_links/{token}. Fields: eventTypeId, hostId, expiresAt, isUsed. Route: /book/otl/{token}. Token auto-expires after booking or TTL.
